hypothesis: Hypothetical campaign • fictional people and institutions • no historical growth chronology
restart_confirm: Replace this tutorial with a new settlement? Your saved campaign remains until you save again.
roles_note: God coordinates both offices. A leader controls their own orders; the other office keeps its standing orders. Switch roles freely.
rations: Use tight rations (75%; wellbeing and cooperation suffer)
pause_notice: Seasons advance only on your order. Citizen movement illustrates seasonal assignments.
labor_note: One adult has one assignment per season. Materials are paid when commissioned; queued projects consume the building crew in order. Idle builders gather food.
units_note: One provision supports one resident for a season. Work points and timber are game units, not archaeological measurements.
milestone: Reach and sustain: %d residents, %d dwellings, %d reserve seasons, wellbeing %d, cooperation %d, protection %d, plus the seven foundation projects. Progress: %d/%d seasons.
complete: Town milestone reached. Your older houses survive beside the new fabric. Continue playing through leadership changes, care, shortages and recovery. This does not establish a historical town at this date.
intro: First, feed the settlement. Assign adults, inspect the forecast, then resolve a season. Keep reserves for winter.
guide_growth: The foundations are built. Enable welcoming, maintain reserves and leave housing room. Arrivals happen in spring; births accumulate slowly. Keep protection and care funded.
guide_sustain: Keep the settlement healthy and secure for four consecutive seasons. Growth can reverse; an empty store or a crowded household still matters.
forecast_line: Food %+d (gathered %d, eaten %d, spoiled %d, losses %d) → %d/%d · timber %+d · building work %d
lead_line: %s — %s, age %d · skill %d/5 · term ends in %d seasons
authority: This order belongs to the other office. Switch role or use God.
invalid_plan: Assignments must use whole workers and cannot exceed available adults.
insufficient_wood: Not enough timber. Gather more before commissioning.
already_ordered: This project is already commissioned or complete.
invalid_candidate: Choose a different eligible adult who is not already holding the other office.
no_active_campaign: Begin or resume a tutorial first.
horizon: This tutorial supports 200 simulated years. Start a new tutorial to explore another path.
saved: Campaign saved. Reference bookmarks and medieval saves are separate.
loaded: Campaign restored; orders and leadership continue from the saved season.
save_failed: The campaign could not be saved. Existing files were left intact.
load_failed: No valid compatible campaign was found. The current settlement was left intact.
cancelled: Project cancelled; unused material share returned. Completed work is not a building.
ordered: Project commissioned. Assign a building crew and resolve seasons to complete it.
assigned: Workforce assigned. Inspect the forecast before resolving.
appointed: Leadership changed. Existing people, projects and orders remain.
welcome_on: Welcoming is enabled; food, space and cooperation determine whether anyone arrives.
resolved: Season resolved. Review the journal and explore citizen activity.
new_campaign: New hypothetical settlement begun. No historical reference objects have been changed.
principle_text:
1. People need food, shelter, care and cooperation; housing alone creates no population.

2. Workers are shared. A larger watch or construction crew reduces gathering and other duties.

3. Projects consume timber and several seasons of labor. Only completed work changes the fabric; older objects keep their IDs.

4. Spring arrivals need spare housing and two seasons of food. Births, adulthood and aging operate over years. All rates are illustrative game balance.

5. Protection combines a watch, experienced leadership and explicit preparations. Predictable seasonal pressure can cost supplies. There are no field battles or standing armies in this tutorial.

6. Office terms last four years. Adults age every season; succession chooses an eligible resident by skill and stable ID. Appointments can be changed in your office.

7. Trust, wellbeing and protection respond gradually. Shortages can cause departure, projects can be cancelled and the settlement can contract.

8. God mode commands both offices without free resources. Leader mode narrows authority; neither mode advances time while you explore.

9. The town milestone is an authoring objective, not a historical classification or automatic upgrade.

10. Watch leaders, stewards, fictional names, rates and events are design interpretation. Yenikapı’s actual political institutions are not established by this model.

events.birth: {count} child born; household care demand continues.
events.town: A sustainable town milestone has been achieved.
events.contracted: The settlement has fallen below the town conditions; rebuild its foundations.

recovery: The town milestone was reached before, but the settlement has contracted. Restore the requirements and sustain them again.
forecast_losses: Unmet food demand: %d · surplus beyond storage: %d
reference_save_notice: Use Save campaign for this hypothetical settlement; reference view bookmarks stay separate.
